mekayis.metin: (يَفَنَ) الْيَاءُ وَالْفَاءُ وَالنُّونُ. يَقُولُونَ: الْيَفَنُ: الشَّيْخُ الْكَبِيرُ.
mekayis.metin_tr: (يَفَنَ) Bu kelimenin harfleri yâ, fâ ve nûndur. Derler ki: yefen (الْيَفَنُ), pek ihtiyarlamış, kocamış kimsedir.

vikisozluk.baslik:
يفن (form I)
# يَفُنُّ (yafunnu) /ja.fun.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of فَنَّ (fanna)
# يُفَنُّ (yufannu) /ju.fan.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of فَنَّ (fanna)
# يَفُنَّ (yafunna) /ja.fun.na/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of فَنَّ (fanna)
# يُفَنَّ (yufanna) /ju.fan.na/: third-person masc

يفنون (form I)
# يَفُنُّونَ (yafunnūna) /ja.fun.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of فَنَّ (fanna)
# يُفَنُّونَ (yufannūna) /ju.fan.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of فَنَّ (fanna)

يفنان (form I)
# يَفُنَّانِ (yafunnāni) /ja.fun.naː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of فَنَّ (fanna)
# يُفَنَّانِ (yufannāni) /ju.fan.naː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of فَنَّ (fanna)

أَتَفَانَى • (ʔatafānā) (form VI) /ʔa.ta.faː.naː/
# first-person singular non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَفَانَى (tafānā)
